This season on this plot, I will keep costs low and farm in the way I can manage with my household. Here in Tabora the rains are seasonal and the dry period is long, so for this intercropped plot I will rely mostly on local practice, family work, and a little organic matter if I can get it. I do not plan to buy much input for this plot, and I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains.
